guidance.bestFor: A flat list of 5 fruits behind an empty prompt option, with Grapes listed but disabled

whenNotToUse.when: A shorter control one height step below the default

guidance.bestFor: Fruits and vegetables under 2 group headings, 3 choices in each, below an ungrouped prompt

whenNotToUse.when: Grouped options the user filters by typing a few letters

guidance.bestFor: The sm size, 4px shorter than the default in every style, on a 2 option list
agentNotes: `size` takes only sm or default; the type has no larger step for a taller control

name: c-native-select-4
title: Native select embedded within a field.
label: Field With Label
description: Native select embedded within a field.

guidance.bestFor: A Country label tied to the control by id, a hint line under it and 3 countries to pick
agentNotes: `FieldLabel` reaches the `select` through `htmlFor` and `id`; give each copy its own id when the field repeats on a page
`FieldDescription` is not linked to the `select`; give it an id and list that id in the select's aria-describedby

guidance.bestFor: The whole control switched off, wrapper and chevron faded to half opacity
agentNotes: `disabled` on `NativeSelect` reaches the `select`, so a native form submit leaves its value out

whenNotToUse.when: One option locked while the rest of the list stays pickable

guidance.bestFor: An error state from aria-invalid alone, turning the border red with no message printed under it
agentNotes: `aria-invalid` is fixed to true here; set it from your validation result so the red border clears once the choice is valid

whenNotToUse.when: An invalid choice that also needs a label and an error message under it
